name: FastSpring
summary: FastSpring is a merchant of record that takes a share of each transaction at rates it quotes through sales, with no published price and no minimum volume. It retries failed renewals 1, 3 and 5 days after a decline and holds new accounts' payouts for 45 days.

facts.text: Card statements show FS* followed by the seller's company name.
FastSpring applies a 2.5% currency conversion fee when the store currency and payout currency differ.
New accounts get a 45-day monitoring hold, and every transaction has a 14-day settlement delay.
The seller terms promise the seller's data in a standard form within 30 days of termination.
A 2022 FastSpring post says moving subscriptions to a new vendor usually takes 10 weeks and covers card tokens but not PayPal agreements.

plans.name: Revenue share
plans.notes: Rates quoted by sales; lower rates for ACH and wire transfers

hiddenCosts: A 2.5% currency conversion fee applies when payout and store currencies differ.
Manual refunds cost $10 by check and $30 by wire.

contract.cancellation: Either side can end the agreement with 30 days' written notice, and FastSpring may hold part of the balance for up to 180 days after termination.
contract.dataExport: CSV reports for orders, subscriptions and returns.
